cards.name: Dwarven Hold
cards.oracle_text:
This land enters tapped.
You may choose not to untap this land during your untap step.
At the beginning of your upkeep, if this land is tapped, put a storage counter on it.
{T}, Remove any number of storage counters from this land: Add {R} for each storage counter removed this way. [STORAGE-COUNTER BATTERY (storage_land, storage_charge_mode:upkeep_if_tapped; NOT a depletion land -- never sacrificed). CHARGE: modelled as +1 storage counter at the END of any turn the land is left UNTAPPED (idle -- not burst; it enters tapped so its play turn banks nothing). This weakly-dominant 'charge while idle' rule reproduces the LITERAL 'hold tapped -> +1 at upkeep' accumulation EXACTLY -- same counter count per turn and same earliest useful burst (turn played + 2), verified off-by-one -- without modelling the hold-tapped board state or an untap-step branch. BURST: an untapped charged storage land is a VARIABLE red mana source (per-permanent yield = Permanent.storage_counters, threaded through BuildPool/BuildAvailableMana/greedy tap/backtracker). A single tap performs a PARTIAL burst: it removes only the payment's remaining shortfall worth of counters (adding that many {R}) and the REST PERSIST on the land for a later turn ('burst some now, bank the rest'); ManaSourceRank taps storage LAST so the shortfall is minimal. How much to burst is a real SEARCH decision -- it falls out of which plan the search commits to (a cheap play bursts a few, the big Dragonstorm/Apex turn bursts many), and the reserve holds the battery untapped whenever the cost is payable without it. Lockstep executor (GameEngine)/rollout (TurnSolver)/planner; every storage path is gated on storage_land so non-storage decks are byte-identical. SIMPLIFICATION: a single tap never bursts MORE counters than the plan needs (goldfish-dominated -- wasted counters), and the rare filter-chain backtracker fallback path is not exercised by this mono-red deck.]
